general.description: Manage sms gateways, sms templates and the record of what was sent.

gateway.labelEnabledHelpText: Only an active gateway is picked to send a message.
gateway.labelAcceptUnknownRegion: Deliver to this gateway even for an unknown country
gateway.labelAcceptUnknownRegionHelpText: A number of a country the shop does not know is otherwise only routed to a gateway that declares GLOBAL. Turn this on to let this gateway take it as well.
gateway.labelPriorityHelpText: The lower the number, the earlier the gateway is picked. A message goes out over one gateway, a failure is not retried on the next one.
gateway.labelSalesChannelHelpText: Leave empty to make the gateway available in every sales channel.
gateway.labelOptionsHelpText: Provider specific settings, given as JSON, e.g. {'{'}"signName":"Shop"{'}'}.
gateway.credentialsEmpty: This provider needs no account details.
gateway.credentialsHelpText: The account details are assigned by the provider, its secrets are shown as password fields.
gateway.emptyStateDescription: Create a gateway to let the shop send messages over a provider.
gateway.removeModalMessage: Delete "{name}"? The template mappings of the gateway go with it, the messages it sent stay in the log.

template.cardAuditLedgerHelpText: What each provider answered for the template of this shop. The state is read back from the provider, it is not typed here.
template.auditLedgerEmpty: The template is not mapped to a provider yet.
template.auditMissingProviderBanner: These providers only send a message once the template is approved, but the template is not mapped to them: {providers}
template.auditLanguageNote: The template is reported in the default language ({locale}).
template.saveFirst: Save the template to map it to a provider.
template.labelTechnicalNameHelpText: The name the business code refers to, unique per installation.
template.labelSceneHelpText: The scene decides the queue priority.
template.labelMaxLengthHelpText: A rendered body longer than this is rejected, leave empty for no limit.
template.labelValiditySecondsHelpText: e.g. the lifetime of an otp. It is read by the caller and does not take part in sending.
template.labelParamsSchemaHelpText: The parameters the template accepts as a JSON list, validated before a message is built.
template.labelContentHelpText: Use {'{'} param {'}'} as placeholder. Empty means the language uses the body of the default language.
template.contentInherited: Uses the body of the default language
template.emptyStateDescription: A verification code template ships with the shop, further ones can be created here.
template.removeModalMessage: Delete "{name}"? The provider mappings of the template go with it.

mapping.emptyState: The template is not mapped to a provider yet, add a row.
mapping.submissionModalTitle: Report the template at the provider
mapping.submissionModalIntro: These are the fields the provider asks for. What the shop already knows about the template is filled in, the rest is up to you.
mapping.confirmModalIntro: The provider cannot be asked for the state of this template. Look it up at the provider and record what you read here.
mapping.confirmNoteHelpText: The note is written to the audit trail of the shop and cannot be left empty.
mapping.helpText: The provider template id and the signature are assigned by the provider. The audit state is what the provider answered, a message goes out once the template is approved.

delivery.emptyStateDescription: Every attempt the shop makes is recorded here.

notification.missingFields: Some required fields are still empty.
